_about: Differential-pair detection patterns + per-class length-skew tolerance. Read by the future `tools/route_diff_pair.py` to constrain intra-pair spacing and warn on length skew > tolerance. Also consumed by `intent/pcb_ir.py:PCBIntent.differential_pair_overrides` so the architect can promote / demote specific pairs per board without editing this file.
_status: v1: scaffold. Tool implementation pending. Schema is stable: changing it requires bumping `version`.
_pattern_order: Specific patterns FIRST, generic catch-all LAST. The matcher consumes pairs greedily by rule order, so the *_P/*_N generic catch-all must sit at the bottom or it will swallow ETH_/LVDS_ pairs before the prefixed rules fire.

patterns._comment: USB 2.0 high-speed pair --- 90 ohm differential, tight skew.
Ethernet 10/100/1000 BASE-T MDI pairs --- 100 ohm differential.
CAN bus --- not a true differential routing target but the tool treats CANH/CANL as a pair for consistent routing.
Generic *_P / *_N suffix pair --- catch-all when no explicit rule matched. MUST stay last.

_meander_comment: v1 emits a warning when intra-pair skew exceeds `max_skew_mm`. Serpentine routing (meander) is a v2 feature; flipping this flag without the tool support will be a no-op until then.
